trigger_description: The currently-granted master requests the full 32-bit trap address 0x00000B00 (unreachable by golden traffic -- random addresses cap at 0x3FC, fixed addresses cap at 0x500) and the slave acks.
observable_effect: The NON-granted master's ack_o is forced high for that same cycle, even though that master never asserted cyc/stb at all -- i.e. BOTH m0_ack_o and m1_ack_o assert simultaneously. This is a textbook 'double-asserts a grant to two requesters' handshake violation: the Wishbone protocol's single-grant invariant (exactly one master's ack active at a time) is broken, which could cause both masters' downstream logic to simultaneously believe they own a completed transaction they never actually participated in.
